quickstart.title: Quick Start
quickstart.subtitle: From zero to your first successful API call in about 3 minutes.

step1.title: Get your API key
step1.desc: After signing up, an initial token is automatically generated. Go to Console → Token Management to copy it.
step1.security: Never expose your API key in frontend code, public repositories, or client apps. Always read it from server-side environment variables.

step2.title: Choose a model
step2.desc: We recommend deepseek-v4-flash for your first call — it's fast, affordable, and great for testing.

step3.title: Choose your calling method
step3.desc: Vancine is OpenAI-compatible. You can call it directly via HTTP or use the official OpenAI SDK.
step3.httpDesc: Use curl, fetch, or any HTTP client to call the REST API directly.
step3.sdkDesc: Drop-in replacement: just change base_url and api_key in your existing OpenAI SDK code.

step4.title: Make your first call
step4.desc: Copy the code below, replace sk-your-api-key with your real key, and run it.

infoTable.title: Essential information
infoTable.tip: GET /v1/models requires an API key and lists models available to the current token. GET /api/pricing is public and exposes endpoint support plus pricing metadata.

exploreMore.title: Explore more
exploreMore.desc: Now that you're up and running, check out what else Vancine can do:

migrate.title: Migrate from OpenAI
migrate.hook: Vancine is fully compatible with the OpenAI API. Existing code usually only needs two changes — base_url and api_key — while everything else (SDK, endpoints, response structure, streaming, function calling) stays the same.

twoChanges.title: Only 2 changes needed
twoChanges.desc: Take your existing OpenAI code, change the base URL and API key, and it works.

fullExamples.title: Full examples
fullExamples.desc: Complete working examples in Python, Node.js, and cURL.

whatStaysSame.title: What stays the same
whatStaysSame.desc: Everything else in your codebase works without modification:

sameItems.sdk: Same openai Python / Node.js SDK — no new dependency
sameItems.functionCalling: Function calling / tool use is supported

comparison.title: Migration comparison
comparison.apiKeyNote: Use your Vancine token from Console → Tokens

nextSteps.title: Next steps
nextSteps.desc: Ready to go deeper? Check out these pages:

chat.title: Chat Completions
chat.desc: Send an OpenAI-compatible messages array to a language model and receive a synchronous JSON response.
chat.reasoningCallout: deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro are reasoning models. content may be empty while reasoning appears in reasoning_content; finish_reason: length often means the token budget was used by reasoning, not that the API failed.

params.maxTokens: Maximum generated tokens; use a larger value for reasoning models

image.title: Image Generation
image.desc: Generate images from text prompts. The response is synchronous JSON with temporary image URLs in the data array.
image.sizeWarning: Doubao-Seedream-5.0-lite requires at least 3,686,400 pixels. 1024x1024 returns “image size must be at least 3686400 pixels”; use 2048x2048. Doubao-Seedream-5.0-pro has no such limit: minimum 921,600 pixels (1024x1024 works), but it only supports single-image generation (no image groups). Both support 1K/2K resolution tiers (lite also supports 3K/4K); the model decides the final size.

params.size: Size in WIDTHxHEIGHT format (see size table below)
params.response_format: Return format: url (default, temporary link valid for 24 hours) or b64_json
params.output_format: Output format: png or jpeg (default jpeg). Only Seedream 5.0 pro/lite support this
params.image: Reference image URL or Base64 for image-to-image / multi-image fusion (5.0 pro: max 10, lite: max 14)
params.watermark: Whether to add watermark. Seedream defaults to false

image.advancedParamsCallout: Advanced Seedream parameters such as sequential_image_generation (image groups) and optimize_prompt_options (prompt optimization) require PassThrough to be enabled on the channel. They are not forwarded by default.

video.title: Video Generation
video.desc: Video generation is asynchronous. Save task_id from the submission response, then poll the same /v1/video/generations/{task_id} path.

params.image: Single reference image URL or Base64 (image-to-video)
params.images: Array of reference image URLs (multi-image input)

video.metadataCallout: metadata sub-parameters: resolution (e.g. 1080p), ratio (aspect ratio e.g. 16:9), frames (frame count), seed (random seed), watermark (boolean), camera_fixed (fixed camera, boolean), generate_audio (generate audio, boolean). These are forwarded to the upstream provider.

td.title: 3D Asset Generation
td.desc: 3D models use the same async task request shape. Submit a task, then poll with task_id for the result.
td.endpointSubmit: 3D also submits through the video async endpoint
td.imagesWarning: Doubao-Seed3D-2.0 requires images. Do not use an image_data field; the Vancine gateway converts images into the upstream content[].image_url format.

params.prompt: Text description of the 3D asset (optional for image-to-3D)
params.images: Reference image URL array for image-to-3D. Doubao-Seed3D-2.0 requires at least one image. Supports public URLs or data:image/...;base64,...

td.asyncCallout: 3D generation is asynchronous. After submitting, save the task_id from the response, then poll GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}. On success, read the 3D model file link from metadata.url in the result.

audio.title: Audio / TTS
audio.desc: The TTS endpoint uses an OpenAI-compatible request body, but the response is binary MP3 audio, not JSON.
audio.endpointWarning: TTS does not use /v1/chat/completions. Using the wrong endpoint can return a misleading 401 that looks like a missing API key; the usual cause is the wrong path.
audio.voiceSuffixCallout: The voice ID suffix determines the model version: uranus suffix is for Doubao-tts2.0, while mars suffix is for Doubao-tts. A voice/model mismatch returns a resource mismatch error.

params.voice: Voice ID, see voice list below
params.response_format: Output audio format: mp3 (default), opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm

auth.title: Authentication
auth.desc: All /v1 requests require an API key in the Authorization header.
auth.securityWarning: Do not put API keys in frontend code, public repositories, or client apps. Read the key from server-side environment variables before calling Vancine.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.desc: Vancine exposes different generation capabilities through OpenAI-compatible endpoints and async task endpoints.

rows.tdNote: Async task with prompt and images support

models.title: Models & Pricing
models.desc: Call the public pricing endpoint to read model names, supported endpoints, ratios, and prices.

errors.title: Error Handling
errors.asyncCallout: For async task failures, read details from data.fail_reason in the polling response.

codes.badRequestCause: Invalid size, missing prompt, or model/endpoint mismatch
codes.unauthorizedCause: Invalid key, or wrong endpoint such as sending TTS to chat
codes.notFoundCause: Check that the URL path is spelled correctly
codes.noChannelCause: No upstream channel is available for this model in the current group

sdks.title: SDKs & Tools
sdks.desc: Vancine text endpoints are compatible with the OpenAI SDK. Multimedia endpoints can also be called with any HTTP client.
sdks.requestsDesc: Good for image, video, 3D, and TTS
sdks.curlDesc: Built in or install with package manager

agents.title: Agent Integration
agents.desc: Before connecting an agent tool, check whether it uses Chat Completions or Responses. Most OpenAI Compatible tools use /v1/chat/completions; Codex CLI official config currently uses /v1/responses.
agents.universalTip: Universal settings: Base URL = {{baseUrl}}, API Key = sk-your-api-key, Model = glm-5.1 or deepseek-v4-flash.

hub.title: Guided setup by coding agent
hub.desc: Dedicated setup guides for popular coding agents: exact configuration, verification status, model entry points and troubleshooting for each tool.

cline.protocol: OpenAI-compatible provider in the Cline extension

hub.cardBoundary: The OpenAI-compatible setup for this tool is ready. Follow its guide to connect it to Vancine.

cli.codex: Codex official config uses ~/.codex/config.toml. Current docs show the Responses protocol, so set wire_api to responses.
cli.openclaw: OpenClaw-style clients usually need the OpenAI-compatible base URL, API key, and model name. Field names vary by distribution; choose OpenAI Compatible when available.
cli.hermes: Hermes Agent OpenAI-compatible plugins commonly use config.yaml or environment variables for base_url and api_key. Use the exact fields from the installed plugin.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.step2: Choose OpenAI Compatible or custom OpenAI API
cursor.step5: Use a text model such as glm-5.1 or deepseek-v4-flash

common.baseUrlDesc: Use this exact Base URL for every OpenAI-compatible request. Do not add extra path segments.
common.configNote: The example only contains placeholder credentials. Replace sk-your-api-key with your own Vancine API key locally; never commit it.
common.modelsDesc: Use any Vancine text (chat) model. Live model capabilities, context limits and prices are maintained on the Models and Pricing pages, not on this page.

baseUrl.symptom: 404, CORS or connection errors; requests hit another host.
baseUrl.fix: Set the Base URL exactly to {{baseUrl}} with no extra path segments.

apiKey.fix: Copy the full Vancine API key without spaces. If it was rotated or deleted, create a new one in your key management.

model.symptom: model not found / model does not exist.
model.fix: Use an exact model ID from the Vancine model list, for example glm-5.1. Model IDs are case-sensitive.

protocol.fix: Check the protocol the tool expects: most OpenAI-compatible tools use Chat Completions (/v1/chat/completions); Codex-style Responses tools need /v1/responses. Choose the matching option in {{tool}}.

common.notOfficial: Vancine is an independent OpenAI-compatible API service. It is not an official provider, partner or built-in integration of {{tool}}.
common.statusCallout: The OpenAI-compatible setup for this tool is ready. Follow this guide to connect it to Vancine.

opencode.valueProp: Connect the OpenCode terminal coding agent to Vancine through one project-level opencode.json file.
opencode.step1: Install OpenCode and check its version.
opencode.step2: Create a Vancine account and an API key if you do not have them yet.
opencode.step3: Create or edit opencode.json in your project root with the configuration above.
opencode.step4: Export VANCINE_API_KEY in your shell before starting OpenCode.
opencode.step5: Start OpenCode, select a model from the vancine provider such as glm-5.1, and send a simple prompt to confirm.
opencode.benchmarkNote: The linked 8-model benchmark was run in the Pi coding agent, not in OpenCode: it shows these models complete real coding-agent tasks through Vancine. OpenCode connectivity itself is covered by the v1.18.3 live check described on this page, and no other OpenCode version has been verified.

cline.valueProp: Point the Cline VS Code extension at Vancine's OpenAI-compatible endpoint and use Vancine models directly in your editor.
cline.step1: Install the Cline extension in VS Code.
cline.step2: Open the Cline settings and choose OpenAI Compatible as the API provider.
cline.step5: Enter a text model ID such as glm-5.1, save, and send a simple message to confirm the connection.

rooCode.valueProp: Point Roo Code at Vancine's OpenAI-compatible endpoint and use Vancine models directly in your editor.
rooCode.step1: Install the Roo Code extension in VS Code.
rooCode.step2: Open the Roo Code provider settings and choose OpenAI Compatible.
rooCode.step5: Enter a text model ID such as glm-5.1, save, and send a simple message to confirm the connection.

verifyKey.q: How do I verify an API key?
verifyKey.a: Call GET {{baseUrl}}/models. HTTP 200 with a model list means the key is valid and has access in the current group.

video3dResults.q: Where do I read video and 3D results?
video3dResults.a: Poll GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}. On success, read data.result_url or data.data.content.video_url.

ttsNotJson.q: Why does TTS not return JSON?
ttsNotJson.a: Successful TTS calls return binary MP3 audio directly with Content-Type audio/mpeg.

seedreamSize.q: Why does Seedream reject my image size?
seedreamSize.a: Doubao-Seedream-5.0-lite requires at least 3,686,400 pixels (use 2048x2048). Doubao-Seedream-5.0-pro has no such limit: minimum 921,600 pixels (1024x1024 works). Set size for the model you use, or pass a 1K/2K tier and let the model decide.
